channel.description: Confirmed news and project updates from the society.

item.title: Founding membership is now open
item.description: Oberlin students can join the mailing list, propose a project, or express interest in an open role.
item.content:encoded: The society is recruiting its first members and officers. Current priorities are confirming the first meeting, choosing one or two semester projects, and gathering the 3-2 questions students want to discuss. Students from any major or class year are welcome.
